name: Aleksandra Komagorkina
bio: Aleksandra is a chemist technologist, who switched to UI/UX design a few years ago and was working on apps from various fields, from fintech to Augmented Reality (some of them are holding first positions in App Store for years). Since then she has worked for a London-based chemistry startup and recently decided to focus solely on making the world better through mobile development. When not coding, she plays the violin, mixes cocktails and writes in a blog about her developer's path.
